Plan: Start Metformin XR 500 mg PO BID with meals. Recheck HbA1c and renal panel in 3-6 months.

publicHealthSignals.title: Potential Signal — Unusual Increase in Acute Fever + Polyarthralgia Presentations
publicHealthSignals.triggerExplanation: Weekly S-Form syndromic fever presentations reached 126 cases vs. 4-week historical baseline of 46 cases (2.74x baseline), accompanied by 39 P-Form clinician-assessed presumptive arboviral cases and 14 L-Form IgM/PCR laboratory-confirmed cases across 3 South River Valley facilities.
limitationsAndConfonders: S-Form syndromic outpatient coding reflects symptom presentations; only 14 of 126 febrile presentations have completed L-Form laboratory confirmation due to a 22-hour batch reporting lag.
Increased clinician awareness following seasonal monsoon advisories may increase P-Form provisional coding sensitivity.
Outpatient-to-diagnostic laboratory referrals across participating clinics can mildly inflate aggregate encounter counts prior to de-duplication.
alternativeExplanations: Seasonal post-monsoon vector-borne arboviral activity (e.g., Chikungunya or Dengue-like febrile illness).
Batch back-entry of outpatient clinic logs from two community health centers on October 18 (reporting completeness 84%).

publicHealthSignals.title: Potential Signal — Upper Respiratory Syndrome Elevation Above Seasonal Threshold
publicHealthSignals.triggerExplanation: Aggregate S-Form acute respiratory encounters rose to 134 weekly visits compared to the moving baseline of 76 (1.76x threshold) across Metro General Hospital and St. Jude Outpatient Wing, with 46 P-Form ILI cases and 13 L-Form PCR confirmations.
limitationsAndConfonders: S-Form syndromic counts do not distinguish viral upper respiratory tract infections from particulate/air-quality airway irritation.
School-reopening attendance screenings contributed to higher mild symptomatic walk-in volume.
alternativeExplanations: Expected autumn influenza/rhinovirus circulation coinciding with post-holiday school return.
Transient regional air quality index (AQI) deterioration over the preceding 5 days.
publicHealthSignals.reviewNotes: Marked Under Review; requested aggregate L-Form respiratory multiplex positivity rates from participating labs.

publicHealthSignals.title: Potential Signal — Localized Acute Gastroenteritis Cluster
publicHealthSignals.triggerExplanation: Aggregate acute gastroenteritis presentations exceeded 2.3x historical baseline for two consecutive weeks in East Harbor District, with 9 L-Form stool culture confirmations.
limitationsAndConfonders: East Harbor reporting completeness is currently 72% with a 36-hour reporting delay from one diagnostic center.
Aggregate counts lack food-exposure or municipal water-zone linkage in de-identified view.
alternativeExplanations: Localized catering or municipal water line maintenance event.
publicHealthSignals.reviewNotes: Escalated to Municipal Water & Sanitation Inspection Team for routine environmental sampling.
